name: Sun Cleric: Warmth applies on a direct heal of a full-health ally (#9162)
contract: Warmth 704563 is a proc-trigger passive whose tooltip reads 'Direct healing now increases the target's health by
... for $704564d.' (Spell.dbc), with no effective-healing or health-threshold qualifier: the direct heal itself
applies 704564 (MOD_INCREASE_HEALTH) to the healed target. Its sibling Faith 707077 has the same wording and
already refreshes on overheal (sun-cleric-faith-overheal-refresh). Illumination 500143 on a full-health ally is
pure overheal (effective heal 0), so it distinguishes a raw-heal gate from an effective-heal gate.

steps.label: Let spawn AI and level scaling settle
Warmth applies although the heal only overheals
